WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Remove all guards

2. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hand Tools and equipment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hand Tools and equipment.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Hand Tools and equipment.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard
